app.title: Colony Detection and Identification (AgarVision colony counter)
app.summary: A person chooses between counting colonies and identifying them by species, and sets a confidence threshold for detections. They upload one or more photos of agar plates. A trained object-detection model runs on each photo. In count mode each annotated image shows its detected colonies boxed, with the total count in the caption. In identify mode the colonies are boxed in a colour for each species, and a legend gives the count per species.

task.text: Count colonies on photos of agar plates automatically, or identify them by species, using a trained detection model with an adjustable confidence threshold.

data.text: Photos of culture plates. A detection model finds bounding boxes in each photo, and each box is assigned to one of a fixed set of classes that the model learned.
data.item: a photo of one agar plate

stage.text: counting colonies from plate photos after incubation, before the counts are analysed

mechanism.text: A mode switch and a confidence slider control how a detection model processes each uploaded image. Each image comes back with its detections drawn as boxes. Below it is either the total count or a colour legend with the count for each species.

field.text: automated colony counting with object detection in microbiology

workflow.name: detect and count objects in each uploaded image, by class

steps.here: A 'Choose Mode' radio switches between Count (one class, a total) and Identify (species classes, a count per species).
A 'Confidence Threshold' slider from 0 to 1 sets the minimum model confidence for a detection to be kept.
A multi-file uploader takes PNG or JPEG plate photos. Each one is written to a temporary file and processed in turn.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: In Count mode a YOLO model boxes every colony in red, and the image caption gives the number of detected colonies.
In Identify mode a second YOLO model classifies each colony. Boxes are coloured by species, and a legend lists each species with its count and colour swatch.

distinctive: Two separate trained models, one for plain colony counting and one for species identification, are switched by a mode control
Detections below a confidence threshold the person chooses are dropped, so the counts change with the threshold
Each species gets a random colour, and a legend links the box colours to the counts per species

parts.title: Colony Detection and Identification page
parts.summary: A single page where the person sets the mode and threshold, uploads plate photos, and gets an annotated image with counts for each one.

parts.title: Mode and confidence controls
parts.summary: A radio button chooses Count or Identify, and a slider sets the minimum detection confidence.

parts.title: Plate image uploader
parts.summary: Accepts several PNG or JPEG plate photos and passes each one to the model as a temporary file.

parts.title: Colony count result
parts.summary: Shows each photo with every detected colony boxed and the total colony count in the caption.

parts.title: Species identification result and legend
parts.summary: Shows each photo with colonies boxed in a colour for each species, and a legend giving each species' count and colour.
